source: game files, patch 0.5.5: DefaultMonsterStats, MonsterVarieties, MonsterTypes, MonsterResistances, GrantedEffects, GrantedEffectsPerLevel, GrantedEffectStatSets, GrantedEffectStatSetsPerLevel, ActiveSkills, Mods, MapTiers, GameConstants

keys.g: the name is the game's own (else worded from the skill's file name)
keys.k: kind: a attack, s spell, d damage over time (per second)
keys.d: damage by type [min, max], where more than one
keys.h: the hit [min, max] at the boss's level (lv)
keys.cm: the cooldown is the one of the move that sets this hit off (matched by name)
keys.ct: cast or attack time, seconds (absent: set by its animation)
keys.x: cannot be evaded, blocked or dodged
keys.w: the working: s skill attack damage %; e skill effectiveness, c [incremental, damage incremental] where not [0.1, 0.0175], b base values per type where not [0.8, 1.2]; m more damage %

Attack.says: level damage × boss damage × skill attack damage × unique rarity, ± damage spread

Spell.says: 3.88521 × skill effectiveness × (1 + incremental × (level − 1)) × (1 + damage incremental)^(level − 1) × skill base value × unique rarity
Spell.open: Boss damage on spells: not in the game files. Path of Building leaves it out and poe2db prints spells without it. Subject to change.

life.says: level life × boss life × unique rarity

res.says: the monster type's resistance sets at the level's resistance step (1: levels 1–45, 2: 46–67, 3: 68+)

tiers.says: a waystone tier is read as its area level (tiers). An attack grows with that level's damage row, a spell with its own formula at that level. The tier bonus tables ship as zeros in 0.5.5.
tiers.label: Subject to change

rarity.says: unique rarity is the game's unique monster modifier: 65% damage, 2900% life. Path of Building's boss export applies the damage one; poe2db prints both without it.
rarity.label: Subject to change

checked: every attack base damage, attack damage % and spell damage poe2db prints for six bosses (639 values, levels 65 to 80) comes out of these formulas without unique rarity, to the unit
the same spell formula (src/Modules/CalcTools.lua); its boss export (src/Export/Scripts/bossData.lua, switched off) applies unique rarity and leaves boss damage off spells
